title: Redesign the Prospectus CRM as the Anthus One admin workspace
description: Implement the Admin-Today, Admin-Pipeline, Admin-Accounts and Admin-Account boards from the Anthus One design (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/3b497d84-bd79-4b8c-87ee-37bf86ff8cce) on the shared Kanbus board and detail surface. Spec: features/admin-workspace.feature. Quota, plans, trials, payments, services engagements, history and the Engagements/Usage and billing/Anthus team/Settings pages show as not yet available until a backend exists. Prospect interests are stored as custom.interests.
